about: The coordinator-readable verdict per style (docs/art.md §2.6, stream A7): whether its frame on its family's sample scene, read at 640x360 beside previews/<slug>.webp, reads as the style without being told, why, and for a style that is not full what is still not there (look.missing). catalogue.py derives look.support from these, the layers and og style check's result.

8bit-pixel.why: flat 4-step blocks, tiny sprites on an exact grid, a banded sky: the early-console language of the preview

monochrome-pixel.why: the handheld greens in Bayer dither, silhouettes on pale ground, one ink on one paper
missing: the sample's ground tile measures 1x2 texels per logical pixel with half rows (the generated tile, resampled, is off the grid): an asset fault the check names, not an engine gap

16bit-pixel.why: ramped shading, the cook's 1-px inside line on every sprite, parallax far layer, saturated keeper against calmer scenery

detailed-pixel.why: dense hue-shifted clusters at 32 px per metre, the grid still visible, scenery rich but quieter

luminous-pixel.why: near-black masses, cyan rim light, the lantern and windows the only warm glows

coarse-pixel.why: a few huge pixels per figure, one dominant night-blue mass, the lamp the only warm point

topdown-tile-pixel.why: upright three-quarter sprites on one repeated grass tile: no tile grid of walls, cliffs and paths, so height and paths do not read as in the preview
missing: a tile set conformed per tile with walls, cliffs and paths (the sample has one grass tile and a far layer drawn as one picture)

expressionist-painting.why: clashing violet and orange brush masses, broken edges, the figures painted into the scene

watercolor-wash.why: translucent washes with pooled rims on white paper, the cook's texel-space paint on every sprite

illuminated-manuscript.why: parchment, gold sun, ink-outlined flat figures, an ornamental border and floral frieze

rubber-hose-animation.why: the sepia film print with grain and scratches, the hose figure and inked props in flat fills; the inked line still measures 5 to 7 px against ArtLine.width 3, the generated art's ink
missing: frame-by-frame animation is content: flipbooks drawn on 12s

gothic-contour.why: misty blue-grey spires fading into haze behind dark ornamental arches, the pale hooded figure, ink contours and the vignette
missing: ornament is content: architecture and characters drawn for the style

lush-painted-worlds.why: opaque warm-lit masses with cool shadow, brushwork in the foliage

decorative-storybook.why: flat patterned planes, ornamental trees and flowers, coloured line

classical-painting-collage.why: old-master fragments with cut seams under one varnish tone, cut-out figures

detailed-doodle.why: fine irregular line over everything, tiny houses and mills, very little colour

black-figure-pottery.why: black silhouettes with incised detail on ochre, meander bands top and bottom

luminous-layered-painting.why: dark cool painted layers, the lantern and village the luminous focal points, mist into depth

bold-comic-illustration.why: thick black outlines on every form, flat posterised fills, a printed-colour sky

pencil-hatching.why: grey graphite hatching over every surface, contour lines, paper white

heavy-ink-shadows.why: outlines and posterised fills draw, but the shadows stay coloured: no solid black masses as in the preview
missing: shadows as solid black ink masses: the frame posterises but keeps the lit colours in shadow (MaterialStyle.shadowTint and the posterize levels do not reach black on these assets)

pixel-3d-hybrid.why: conformed pixel sprites (hero, tree) stand as billboards with drop shadows among low-detail 3D props, dithered and depth-blurred

low-resolution-3d.why: nearest textures and a slight pixel grid draw, but at this distance the scene reads as plain 3D, not early console; the far hills stay over the face budget
missing: the far hills (596 faces) stay over propFaces 300: decimation within ArtShape.silhouette cannot reach the budget, so the cook keeps them whole
a frame that reads as early 3D: logicalHeight 240 with nearest textures barely shows at 640x360 (vertex wobble and affine warp are not in the engine)

monochrome-dither-3d.why: two colours, a fine ordered dither carries the light: the tree, hero, crate, lantern and hills keep their forms in perspective

faceted-low-poly.why: the tree's facets read, but the hero is kept whole at 332 faces (over propFaces 200) and stays round, and the crate keeps its wood texture
missing: decimation that reaches propFaces 200 on a hero built of capsules and spheres: within ArtShape.silhouette it stops at 332 and the cook keeps it

sculpted-clay.why: the 2 cm bevel is too small to see at this distance and the surfaces are plain PBR: nothing reads as clay
missing: a clay surface: no fingerprint or soft subsurface look in the frame, and a 2 cm bevel does not show at play distance

voxel-worlds.why: the tree, hero and hills are stepped cubes on one grid, single-colour faces

paper-craft.why: flat facets and outlines draw, but there is no paper grain, fold or layered card
missing: paper: no card grain, folds or layered sheets in the frame (the assets must be built as sheets, og-model's paper fold recipe)

miniature-diorama.why: the tilt-shift blur reads as miniature, but the props are plain PBR, not toy-like or bevelled
missing: toy-like materials and bevels the assets do not carry (the frame's tilt-shift alone does not make a diorama)

minimal-geometric.why: flat untextured colour planes, baked one colour per face, no texture anywhere

neon-vector.why: black faces under glowing cyan lines on a dark field, bloom on the lantern (neon-vector's own sources, tools/art-samples/neon.py)

anime-cel-3d.why: two-tone cel bands, dark outlines on every model, a clean sky

inked-comic-3d.why: heavy ink contours and hatched fills over the whole frame

painterly-3d.why: no brush marks: the textures and primitives draw as plain lit 3D
missing: painted assets: brush-stroke textures and soft painted forms (the frame's paint filter does not show on these assets)

cinematic-realism.why: primitive blockouts with photo textures under a filmic grade: not realistic assets
missing: realistic assets: scanned or generated models and textures at ArtTexels.density 512 (the sample's crate and ground measure 213 and 128 texels/m)

muted-cinematic-3d.why: the muted grade draws, but the primitives read as a blockout
missing: detailed realistic assets: the grade alone over primitives reads as a blockout

layered-silhouette.why: every form a flat dark silhouette in depth bands against a pale sky
